headline: Sent ordinance allowing electronic public comment for residents with disabilities to full board with no recommendation.
summary: Amended Ordinance O-26-002 would let people with disabilities take part in public comment electronically at full board meetings. A motion to recommend its final passage failed, so the ordinance was sent to the full board with no recommendation. Six appointments to city boards and commissions were recommended.
decisions: Placed on file a communication from Alderman Paula Johnson on a proposed amendment to Ordinance O-26-002.
Placed on file a communication from the Office of Corporation Counsel on Ordinance O-26-002.
Recommended re-appointment of Charles Emmons to the Arts Commission, with a term to expire July 30, 2029. Motion carried.
Recommended re-appointment of Carl Andrade to the Business and Industrial Development Authority, with a term to expire September 13, 2028. Motion carried.
Recommended re-appointment of Frank Teas to the Electric Aggregation Committee, with a term to expire August 31, 2028. Motion carried.
Recommended Jane Goodman as a new appointee to the Homeless Services Gap Analysis Committee. Motion carried.
Recommended LaTonya Muccioli as a new appointee to the Homeless Services Gap Analysis Committee. Motion carried, with Alderman Thibeault opposed.
Recommended Tonia Knisley as a new appointee to the Homeless Services Gap Analysis Committee. Motion carried.
Approved amendment to O-26-002 adding that the Risk Department shall determine eligibility. Motion carried.
Approved amendment to O-26-002 adding a November 15, 2026 effective date. Motion carried.
Denied motion to recommend final passage of O-26-002 as amended. Motion failed.
Sent O-26-002 to the full Board of Aldermen with no recommendation. Motion carried.
